questions.stem: What does 'Ich bin Mitglied in einem Sportverein' mean?
options: I am a fan of a sports team in town
I am a member of a sports club
I am a coach at a sports club
I work in a sports shop
questions.explanation: 'Das Mitglied' is a member and 'der Verein' a club. Clubs are the usual way to play organised sport in Germany, rather than through school.

questions.stem: Which verb completes 'Meine Schwester ___ seit drei Jahren Geige.'?
options: treibt
fährt
läuft
spielt
questions.explanation: Instruments and ball games take 'spielen': 'Geige spielen', 'Fußball spielen'. 'Treiben' goes with 'Sport', and 'fahren' with 'Rad' or 'Ski'.

questions.stem: What does 'Das Spiel endete unentschieden' mean?
options: The game was called off early
The game ended in a narrow loss
The game ended in a draw
The game was won on penalties
questions.explanation: 'Unentschieden' means undecided, so neither team won: a draw, such as 2:2. A win is 'gewinnen' or 'der Sieg', a loss 'verlieren' or 'die Niederlage'.

questions.stem: After your first training session you say 'Ich habe Muskelkater.' What do you mean?
options: I have injured my knee
I am already much fitter
I have caught a cold
My muscles are sore
questions.explanation: 'Der Muskelkater' is the stiffness and soreness in your muscles a day or two after unusual exercise. It has nothing to do with a cat, despite 'Kater'.

questions.stem: Which sentence means 'I like reading, I prefer drawing, but I like dancing best of all'?
options: 'Ich lese am liebsten, ich zeichne lieber, aber gern tanze ich.'
'Ich lese gern, ich zeichne lieber, aber am liebsten tanze ich.'
'Ich lese lieber, ich zeichne gern, aber am liebsten tanze ich.'
'Ich lese gern, ich zeichne am liebsten, aber lieber tanze ich.'
questions.explanation: Likes go up in three steps: 'gern' (like), 'lieber' (prefer), 'am liebsten' (like best). Each is placed with the verb it describes.

questions.stem: What does 'basteln' mean?
options: To go hiking in the mountains
To play board games with your friends
To work in the garden
To make things by hand as a craft
questions.explanation: 'Basteln' is making things by hand, such as models, decorations or cards. Hiking is 'wandern', and gardening is 'im Garten arbeiten'.

questions.stem: 'In meiner Freizeit gehe ich zweimal pro Woche klettern, und am Wochenende spiele ich in einer Band.' How often does the writer go climbing?
options: Twice a week
Every weekend
Once a week
Every day
questions.explanation: 'Zweimal pro Woche' means twice a week. The weekend is when the writer plays in a band.

questions.stem: What does 'Ich habe heute keine Lust auf Sport' mean?
options: I don't feel like doing sport today
I have no time for sport today
I am not allowed to do any sport today
I am not good at sport today
questions.explanation: 'Lust haben auf' means to feel like something. Having no time would be 'keine Zeit haben', and not being allowed 'nicht dürfen'.

questions.stem: What does 'Ich mache mir nichts aus Computerspielen' mean?
options: I spend nothing on computer games
I'm not keen on computer games
I make my own computer games
I've given up computer games
questions.explanation: 'Sich nichts aus etwas machen' is an idiom meaning not to care for something. It has nothing to do with making or spending.

questions.stem: What does 'sich gesund ernähren' mean?
options: To get enough sleep
To recover from an illness
To eat a healthy diet
To exercise every day
questions.explanation: 'Sich ernähren' means to feed oneself or eat, and 'die Ernährung' is diet or nutrition. Exercising would be 'sich bewegen' or 'Sport treiben'.

questions.stem: What does 'der Bewegungsmangel' mean?
options: A broken leg
A lack of exercise
Pain in the muscles
A slow heartbeat
questions.explanation: 'Bewegung' is movement or exercise, and 'der Mangel' a lack. It is often blamed on long hours sitting at a desk or a screen.

questions.stem: At the doctor's you say 'Ich habe seit gestern Halsschmerzen und Fieber.' What is wrong?
options: A sore throat and a temperature since yesterday
A headache and a cough since yesterday
A sore throat and a temperature for a week
A stomach ache and a temperature since this morning
questions.explanation: 'Halsschmerzen' are a sore throat, 'Fieber' is a temperature, and 'seit gestern' with the present tense means since yesterday and still now.

questions.stem: What do you say to a friend who is ill?
options: 'Viel Glück!'
'Guten Appetit!'
'Gute Reise!'
'Gute Besserung!'
questions.explanation: 'Gute Besserung!' means 'Get well soon!'. 'Viel Glück' is 'good luck', 'Guten Appetit' is said before a meal and 'Gute Reise' before a trip.

questions.stem: Which word completes 'Mir tut ___ Rücken weh.'?
options: den
dem
die
der
questions.explanation: In 'wehtun' the body part is the subject, so it is nominative: 'der Rücken'. The person who hurts is in the dative ('mir').

questions.stem: 'Früher habe ich jeden Tag Cola getrunken. Seit ich nur noch Wasser trinke, fühle ich mich fitter.' What has changed?
options: She drinks water only after exercise
She drinks only water now and feels fitter
She drinks more cola and feels more tired
She has started drinking cola again every day
questions.explanation: 'Früher' (in the past) contrasts with 'seit ich nur noch Wasser trinke' (since I have drunk only water). 'Fitter' is the result.

questions.stem: Which sentence gives advice about staying healthy?
options: 'Man sollte jeden Tag eine halbe Stunde an die frische Luft gehen.'
'Ich bin gestern eine halbe Stunde an der frischen Luft gewesen.'
'Die Luft war heute Morgen sehr frisch und ziemlich kalt.'
'Wir gehen morgen eine halbe Stunde zusammen spazieren.'
questions.explanation: 'Man sollte' ('one should') is the usual way to give general advice. The other sentences report the past, describe the weather or state a plan.

questions.stem: What is 'die Apotheke'?
options: A hospital
A health food shop
A pharmacy
A doctor's surgery
questions.explanation: In Germany most medicines are sold in an 'Apotheke', marked by a red A. A doctor's surgery is 'die Arztpraxis', and a hospital 'das Krankenhaus'.

questions.stem: 'Wer viel am Schreibtisch sitzt, sollte regelmäßig Pausen machen.' Who is the advice for?
options: Anyone who does a lot of sport
Anyone who is already ill
Anyone who sleeps badly
Anyone who sits at a desk a lot
questions.explanation: 'Wer ...' here means 'whoever' or 'anyone who'. The clause 'wer viel am Schreibtisch sitzt' names the people the advice is for.

questions.stem: What is the difference between 'die Ferien' and 'der Urlaub'?
options: 'Ferien' are school or university holidays; 'Urlaub' is leave from work or a trip
'Ferien' are leave from work; 'Urlaub' is the holidays of schools and universities
'Ferien' are holidays in summer only; 'Urlaub' is a holiday in winter only
'Ferien' are trips in Germany; 'Urlaub' is always a holiday spent abroad
questions.explanation: Schools and universities have 'Ferien'. Workers take 'Urlaub', and anyone can go 'in Urlaub' on a holiday trip.

questions.stem: Why do the German states not all start their summer holidays on the same date?
options: Each school chooses its own dates
Summer starts later in the north than in the south
The dates depend on the local harvest
The dates are staggered to spread out holiday traffic
questions.explanation: The states agree a staggered timetable, so that not all families take to the roads and resorts at once. The dates are set by each state, not by individual schools.

questions.stem: What is 'eine Jugendherberge'?
options: A youth hostel
A campsite
A holiday flat
A youth club
questions.explanation: 'Die Herberge' is a lodging, and a 'Jugendherberge' offers cheap beds, often in shared rooms. A campsite is 'der Campingplatz', and a holiday flat 'die Ferienwohnung'.

questions.stem: What does 'Wir haben eine Pauschalreise nach Mallorca gebucht' mean?
options: We booked a package holiday to Mallorca
We booked only a flight to Mallorca
We booked a cruise around Mallorca
We booked a hotel room in Mallorca only
questions.explanation: A 'Pauschalreise' is a package holiday, with travel and accommodation booked together at one price. 'Pauschal' means all-inclusive or flat-rate.

questions.stem: Which sentence says where you went on holiday last year?
options: 'Letztes Jahr sind wir an die Ostsee gefahren.'
'Letztes Jahr haben wir an die Ostsee gefahren.'
'Letztes Jahr sind wir an der Ostsee gefahren.'
'Letztes Jahr wir sind an die Ostsee gefahren.'
questions.explanation: 'Fahren' takes 'sein' in the perfect, movement to a coast takes 'an' + accusative ('an die Ostsee'), and after a fronted time phrase the verb comes second.

questions.stem: Which preposition completes 'Im Winter fahren wir ___ die Berge.' ('to the mountains')?
options: nach
zu
an
in
questions.explanation: German says 'in die Berge fahren' for going to the mountains. 'Nach' is used with towns and most countries, 'an' with the sea or a lake.

questions.stem: 'Das Hotel lag direkt am Strand, aber das Zimmer war winzig und das Frühstück enttäuschend.' What is the writer's overall view?
options: Mixed: a great location, but a poor room and breakfast
Wholly positive about every part of the stay
Wholly negative about every part of the stay
Positive about the breakfast, negative about the beach
questions.explanation: 'Aber' divides the review: the location by the beach is good, while the tiny room ('winzig') and the disappointing breakfast ('enttäuschend') are not.

questions.stem: What does 'Ich bin urlaubsreif' mean?
options: I am too old for holidays
I have booked my holiday
I badly need a holiday
I have just come back from holiday
questions.explanation: 'Reif' means ripe or ready, so 'urlaubsreif' is being ready for, and in need of, a holiday, usually from tiredness.

questions.stem: What does 'die Jugendarbeitslosigkeit' mean?
options: Youth work
Child labour
Youth welfare
Youth unemployment
questions.explanation: The compound is 'Jugend' (youth) + 'Arbeitslosigkeit' (unemployment), from 'arbeitslos', without work.

questions.stem: What is 'ein Ausbildungsplatz'?
options: A part-time job alongside school
A place at a primary school
A place as a trainee in vocational training
A place to study medicine at a university
questions.explanation: 'Die Ausbildung' is vocational training, such as training to be a mechanic or a nurse, and the 'Ausbildungsplatz' is a trainee position with a company.

questions.stem: 'Viele junge Leute finden nach der Schule keine Arbeit, weil ihnen Erfahrung fehlt.' Why do they not find work?
options: There are no jobs at all
They lack experience
They have no qualifications
They do not want to work
questions.explanation: 'Weil ihnen Erfahrung fehlt' means 'because they lack experience'. 'Fehlen' takes the dative: 'mir fehlt', 'ihnen fehlt'.

questions.stem: What does 'Er ist vom Alkohol abhängig' mean?
options: He has given up alcohol
He is allergic to alcohol
He sells alcohol
He is dependent on alcohol
questions.explanation: 'Abhängig von' means dependent on, so this describes an addiction. Giving something up is 'aufhören mit' or 'verzichten auf'.

questions.stem: What is 'die Suchtberatung'?
options: A police search for illegal drugs at a party
A lesson about healthy eating
Counselling for people with an addiction
A ban on selling addictive drugs
questions.explanation: 'Die Sucht' is addiction and 'die Beratung' advice or counselling. Such services help people with addictions and their families.

questions.stem: 'Rauchen ist in vielen öffentlichen Gebäuden verboten, und immer weniger Jugendliche fangen damit an.' What trend is described?
options: More and more young people take up smoking
Smoking is now allowed in public buildings
Young people smoke only in public buildings
Fewer and fewer young people take up smoking
questions.explanation: 'Immer weniger' means fewer and fewer, and 'damit anfangen' means to start it, here smoking.

questions.stem: What does 'Prävention ist besser als Strafe' mean?
options: Punishment is better than prevention
Education is better than prevention
Prevention is better than punishment
Prevention is better than a cure
questions.explanation: 'Die Prävention' is prevention and 'die Strafe' is punishment. The cure would be 'die Heilung'.

questions.stem: What does 'Frauen werden im Beruf oft benachteiligt' mean?
options: Women often change jobs
Women often work part-time in offices
Women are often disadvantaged at work
Women are often promoted at work
questions.explanation: 'Benachteiligen' means to disadvantage or treat unfairly, from 'der Nachteil' (disadvantage). 'Werden' + participle is the passive.

questions.stem: What does the slogan 'Gleicher Lohn für gleiche Arbeit' demand?
options: Equal pay for equal work
Equal work for everyone
Higher pay for harder work
Less work for the same pay
questions.explanation: 'Der Lohn' is pay or wages, so the slogan demands that people doing the same work earn the same, whatever their gender.

questions.stem: 'Ich finde es unfair, dass meine Schwester im Haushalt mehr helfen muss als ich, nur weil sie ein Mädchen ist.' What is the speaker's attitude?
options: He thinks his sister is lazy and should help much more
He is proud that he does more housework than his sister
He thinks his sister is treated unfairly because she is a girl
He wants to do less housework than his sister does now
questions.explanation: 'Ich finde es unfair' gives his view, and 'nur weil sie ein Mädchen ist' gives the reason: his sister does more housework only because of her gender.

questions.stem: In a school, what does 'die Inklusion' mean?
options: Teaching every subject in German
Dividing students into classes by ability
Taking in new students in the middle of the school year
Students with and without disabilities learning together
questions.explanation: 'Inklusion' means including everyone: students with disabilities learn in the same classes as other students rather than in separate schools.
